rationale: Register the one question the parent account's discriminator still carries, so it is an explicit obligation rather than prose: whether anything inside the sealed configuration bounds or repairs the reported index drift after many more re-synchronization rounds and further leader changes, or whether the drift continues one index per round without any in-configuration repair. The gap is scoped to the parent's latest fixed experiment, whose cases produce the drift the question asks about.

gaps.question: Does anything inside the sealed configuration bound or repair the reported accepted and decided index drift after many more re-synchronization rounds and further leader changes, or does the drift continue one index per round with the decided log unreadable throughout?
